text: Scope decisions at creation (Nov 2026), chosen by the user: no profile/settings tools (/api/me GET or PATCH) because API units are fixed (ml, grams) and nothing needs them; insights are not in the API and were not rebuilt. Rejected in review: rejecting future-dated breastfeeding sessions (other log tools accept future times too; the server decides), and extra API-key scrubbing of timezone errors and successful response bodies (only reachable if the key is misconfigured into another field or echoed by the server).
author: Stavros Korokithakis <hi@stavros.io>
